— or — paste image URLs (Pinterest)
Grab a whole Pinterest board at once →
  1. Open your Pinterest board and scroll all the way down so every pin loads.
  2. Make a new browser bookmark, and paste the code below as its URL (web address). Name it "Grab pins".
  3. Click that bookmark while on the board — it copies every pin's image URL.
  4. Come back here, paste into the box above, and hit Add these URLs.
javascript:(function(){try{var u=[].slice.call(document.images).map(function(i){return i.currentSrc||i.src}).filter(function(s){return s&&s.indexOf('i.pinimg.com')>-1});u=u.filter(function(s,i){return u.indexOf(s)===i});var t=u.join('\n');function d(){alert(u.length+' Pinterest image URLs copied. Paste them into Field Read.')}if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText){navigator.clipboard.writeText(t).then(d,f)}else{f()}function f(){var a=document.createElement('textarea');a.value=t;document.body.appendChild(a);a.select();try{document.execCommand('copy')}catch(e){}a.remove();d()}}catch(e){alert('Grab failed: '+e.message)}})();

Some images may still refuse to load (the host blocks reading their pixels) — those are skipped and counted, the rest go through fine.
